data.name: Holiday Inn Uruapan by IHG
data.address: Blvd. Industrial 1705, Uruapan, 60120 Uruapan, Mich., Mexico
data.description:
In an industrial area off Highway 14D, this casual hotel is 2.1 km from the Parroquia San Francisco and 4.4 km from Barranca del Cupatitzio National Park.
The unassuming rooms come with free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and coffeemakers. Suites offer kitchenettes, minibars, and separate living rooms with pull-out sofas. Kids age 18 and under stay for no extra charge with a parent. Room service is offered.
There's a colorful regional restaurant, as well as a bar with regular live music. Other amenities include an outdoor pool, and a fitness room with floor-to-ceiling windows. Parking is complimentary.
